items.source: request - the current web request
items.translation: request - 当前的 Web 请求

items.source: This interceptor makes JPA EntityManagers available via the current thread, which will be autodetected by transaction managers. It is suitable for service layer transactions via JpaTransactionManager or JtaTransactionManager as well as for non-transactional read-only execution.
items.translation: 该拦截器通过当前线程提供 JPA EntityManagers，事务管理器将自动检测它们。它适用于通过 JpaTransactionManager 或 JtaTransactionManager 进行的服务层事务，也适用于非事务性只读执行。

items.source: In contrast to OpenEntityManagerInViewFilter, this interceptor is set up in a Spring application context and can thus take advantage of bean wiring.
items.translation: 与OpenEntityManagerInViewFilter相比，此拦截器在 Spring 应用程序上下文中进行配置，因此可以利用 Bean 的装配。

items.source: Note: Will only be called if this interceptor's preHandle method has successfully completed!
items.translation: 注意：仅当此拦截器的preHandle方法成功完成时才会调用！

items.source:
Allows for preparing context resources (such as a Hibernate Session)
and expose them as request attributes or as thread-local objects.
items.translation: 允许准备上下文资源（例如 Hibernate Session），并将其作为请求属性或线程本地对象暴露。

items.source:
Allows for modifying context resources after successful handler
execution (for example, flushing a Hibernate Session).
items.translation: 允许在成功执行处理器后修改上下文资源（例如刷新 Hibernate 会话）。

items.source: Called instead of postHandle and afterCompletion, when the handler started handling the request concurrently.
items.translation: 在处理器并发处理请求时，会调用此方法而不是`postHandle`和`afterCompletion`。

items.source:
Suffix that gets appended to the EntityManagerFactory toString
representation for the "participate in existing entity manager
handling" request attribute.
items.translation: 附加到 EntityManagerFactory 的 toString 表示中的后缀，用于“参与现有实体管理器处理”请求属性。

items.source:
Return the name of the request attribute that identifies that a request is
already filtered. Default implementation takes the toString representation
of the EntityManagerFactory instance and appends ".FILTERED".
items.translation: 返回标识请求已过滤的请求属性名称。默认实现采用 `EntityManagerFactory` 实例的 `toString()` 表示形式并追加 ".FILTERED"。

items.source: model - the map of model objects that will be exposed to the view (may be null). Can be used to analyze the exposed model and/or to add further model attributes, if desired.
items.translation: `model` - 将暴露给视图的模型对象映射（可为 `null`）。可用于分析已暴露的模型和/或根据需要添加更多模型属性。

items.source: ex - exception thrown on handler execution, if any
items.translation: ex - 如果在执行处理器时抛出异常，则为该异常

items.source: Intercept the execution of a request handler after its successful invocation, right before view rendering (if any).
items.translation: 在成功调用请求处理器之后、视图渲染（如果有）之前拦截其执行。

items.source: Intercept the execution of a request handler before its invocation.
items.translation: 在请求处理器被调用之前拦截其执行。

items.source:
Callback after completion of request processing, that is, after rendering
the view.
items.translation: 请求处理完成后的回调，即在渲染视图之后。
